title: werk MANIFEST.json — the base shape every profile shares (major version 1)
description: What EVERY werk manifest of major version 1 looks like, whatever its profile. A profile's own manifest schema (the one the manifest names in `manifest_schema`) is a REFINEMENT of this one: it pins `profile`, closes the objects this schema leaves open, adds its conventions and its node types. This schema is deliberately OPEN (it sets no additionalProperties:false anywhere) and deliberately small, because its job is different from a profile schema's: it is the part a reader holds itself. A reader validates a manifest against the schema the package carries — that establishes that the package is consistent with what it ships — and against THIS schema, which it has built in — that establishes that the manifest is a werk manifest at all, whatever the package's own schema says. A package cannot loosen this schema by shipping a permissive one. See spec/SPEC.md section 2.2 and section 10.3. Standalone: no $ref to any other file.

profile.description: `<name>/<revision>`: a kebab-case name, a slash, an incremental integer, and optionally a kebab-case status suffix (`model/1-draft`). `3d-entity/1` and `image/1` are the reference profiles; any other value names a profile whose documents travel inside the package (spec/SPEC.md section 2.2).

manifest_schema.description: Path inside this package of the JSON Schema that validates this manifest. Optional only for the two reference profiles, whose default paths are fixed; MANDATORY for every other profile.

profile_spec.description: Path inside this package of the NARRATIVE specification of the profile: the document a reader starts with, and the one that carries the normative 'Writing a minimal valid ...' section. Absent means spec/SPEC.md for 3d-entity/1 and spec/PROFILE-IMAGE.md for image/1.

conventions.description: Law 8. The six BASE conventions below are the ones every reader depends on to read any werk at all — the container, the manifest and the envelope frame — so they are mandatory in every profile and pinned here. Everything else in this object is the profile's, declared by the profile's own schema and by the package's conventions map.

primary.description: Slot name to node_id. Which slots exist is the profile's business; that each value is a node id is everybody's.

formats.description: Format id to the path, inside this package, of that format's DEFINITION DOCUMENT (spec/SPEC.md section 3.18). Parallel to `schemas` and `layouts`. Lists the formats the package's nodes name and the definitions those build on; absent or empty when no node carries a foreign-encoded file.

path.description: Package-relative POSIX path. No leading slash, no drive letter, no '..' segment, no backslash. Case-sensitive.

type.description: `core.<family>...` is the profile's constitution, `x.<owner>...` the open frontier. Which core.* types a profile has is that profile's schema's business; that every type is one or the other is law 12.
